Claim.title: claim
Claim.description: NX-019. One evidence-bound Claim extracted from persisted conversation Messages: candidate knowledge, never a formal business object. Identity, tenant, world, consumer and evidence are server-derived; extractors never produce verified_fact. Not an existing upstream API.

ref.description: consumer: server-derived consumer object id; otherwise empty

text.description: referent words present in the topic window, or empty

condition.description: verbatim condition clause; required when modality=conditional

anchor.description: server acceptance time of the cited Message

span_start.description: Unicode code point offset into the Message body

content_hash.description: sha256 of the full Message body (UTF-8)

correlation_key.description: same consumer+kind+predicate+normalized value+polarity; links repeats, never deduplicates

allOf.description: extractors never produce verified_fact; only verification channels may, outside this contract

ContextPackV6.title: context-pack-v6
ContextPackV6.description: NX-023 Context pack v6. Message Runs: the frozen v2 core (bindings, user_statement, formal_facts, current_constraints, supply), or the v4 core when the optional relationship_context section is present (current statements are resolved user statements only; hypotheses are evidence only), re-derived by SQL at bind; Role Runs: the frozen v3/v5 core under role and a service-trigger current_event, plus strategy, goal/control snapshot, labelled item sections, budget report and explicit insufficiency. Every item cites its source revision, canonical content hash and the current READ decision it was read under; SQL re-verifies each against the source row. Formal sections carry only governed objects/policy/ledger state; Claims under review appear only as source text; hypotheses never enter a real-world Context. No floating-point numbers. Server-assembled; grants nothing. v2-v5 stay frozen and old Runs keep using them.
